notes: Evidence check passes. The thank-you card, ADW presenting block and 'Back the storm' block match site-sponsors-intro.png, site-sponsors-adw.png and site-sponsors-join.png word for word. All seven sponsors in sponsors.html appear (ADW, Kirti Law, Novelty Physiotherapy & Wellness, Pizza 24, The Polly Fox, Abbotsford Dental Centre, IBJ Cafe Burgers & Boba). The six logo tiles match the site-sponsor-*.png captures, with no recolouring or distortion: tile aspect is about 1.6, the same as the captures. (778) 964-6999 matches the footer tel link. shuttlestorm.adawar.org/sponsors is the page's canonical URL. The end-lockup mark is byte-identical to the site's favicon.svg. The volt underlines are flat overlays that sit correctly under 'local / businesses back local badminton' (frames 16–100) and 'BACK THE' (frames 140–239). No glow, glass, particles or invented claims.

Main defect, a docking collision (frames ~113–121; see sampled frame 116 and frame 119): the 'Back the storm' card travels up over the sponsor wall and covers the whole second tile row, hiding The Polly Fox, Abbotsford Dental Centre and IBJ Cafe for about 0.25 s before the wall finishes shrinking upward. Three of the seven sponsors disappear at the moment the wall is supposed to cause the ask. The cause → consequence read becomes a collision.

Travel speed: between frames 112 and 116 the join card moves about 835 px (peaking near 300 px/frame), which reads as a whip, not a dock. The wall moves up and scales down at the same time, so two large surfaces move fast in opposite senses.

Opening dead space: frame 0 has the top ~600 px (31%) of the frame empty, and frame 16 still has ~280 px empty, while the camera tilts up to the thank-you card. This is empty travel before the action.

Convergence is mostly clean, but at frames ~44–52 tiles stack on top of each other mid-flight (frame 48: IBJ covers half of the Abbotsford Dental tile, and Novelty and Pizza 24 overlap). The wall locks cleanly by frame 56 and holds well through frame 104.

End state is strong: one centred column (ADW, 3×2 supporters, ask, phone, URL, lockup) with a stable hold from about frame 148 to 239 (~3 s). At 360 px wide, the phone, headline, ask copy and buttons are readable. Logo names are recognisable, but logo sub-lines (CORPORATION, PHYSIOTHERAPY & WELLNESS) are not, which is acceptable.

Reference fit: fragments converging into one system followed by a consequence matches openmontage-hook. The camera grammar is thinner, though: a tilt plus one convergence, with no real pullback reveal.

Fixes: (1) Make the join card's top depend on the wall's animated bottom edge (top ≥ wall bottom + 24–30 px every frame), or move the wall and the card as one rigid group, so the card never overlaps a tile. (2) Let the wall finish its rise and scale, then dock the card with an ease-out capped at about 60–80 px/frame, spread over 14–18 frames instead of 4. (3) Start frame 0 with the thank-you card already filling the upper frame, or start the tilt from a tighter framing, so the top third is never empty. (4) Stagger the tile paths during convergence so no tile passes over another (frames 44–52). Keep everything else as it is.
